cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you catch that bus: yesterday you said work kept you till six. Why is your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I went home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down; the lift still stands. Tell me where you stopped before we go.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 stops the departure for a discrepancy; A3 offers a ride to retain B; A5 renews the ride while requiring the still-missing destination before leaving.

responseLogic.evidence: A1 explicitly dates the disputed work trip yesterday; B4 went home belongs to that trip and A3 drive home is the current offered journey.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs the last bus and B4 partially explains the early departure while omitting the stop.

heightening.evidence: B4 stop answers the time contradiction only partly, causing A5 to hold the conversation on the omitted destination.

specificity.evidence: A1 work-six versus taxi-five and B2 last bus establish both inquiry and departure pressure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 seat instruction, continued transport offer and missing detail are all needed to keep B present without withdrawing the accommodation.
